Source commit: 81c86964832fc99750ba475861a78b40960e2e5c
Source path: Packages/UIEffect/Scripts/UIGradient.cs
Adapted in AvionicsUi/AvSurfaceGradient.cs: rect-space vertex colour interpolation and multiplication.
The adaptation uses Unity's BaseMeshEffect, restricts the gradient to vertical instrument shading,
and removes text, rotation, editor serialization, and material dependencies.
This is a source adaptation, not a bundled installation of the complete UIEffect package.
